evals.name: multi-leg-fly-from-chat-option-4
evals.prompt: Create an OO custom signals CSV for this trade — SPX call butterfly, opened Friday Oct 10 2025 at 9:32 AM, closed same day at 3:59 PM. Legs (all expire Oct 31 2025): BTO 1 6815 C @ 48.25, STO 2 6855 C @ 43.70, BTO 1 6895 C @ 20.85.

assertions.text: signal.csv exists somewhere under outputs/ (under an _all/ subfolder per the skill's convention)
Header row is exactly 'OPEN_DATETIME,CLOSE_DATETIME,BUY_SELL,CALL_PUT,STRIKE,EXPIRATION,QUANTITY' — no quoting, no surrounding whitespace
CSV has exactly 3 data rows (one per leg) plus 1 header row
Every row has OPEN_DATETIME = '2025-10-10 09:32' (24-hour, no seconds, no AM/PM, no quoting)
Every row has CLOSE_DATETIME = '2025-10-10 15:59'
Every row has EXPIRATION = '2025-10-31'
Every row has CALL_PUT = 'C'
BUY_SELL column contains exactly the values B, S, B (in any leg order)
STRIKE column contains exactly the values 6815, 6855, 6895 (no trailing zeros like 6815.0)
QUANTITY column contains the values 1, 2, 1 corresponding to strikes 6815, 6855, 6895 respectively
No data value or header is wrapped in double quotes
A README.md exists in the same folder as signal.csv documenting source/methodology/format option
No by-block/ subdirectory was created (the signal is not tied to a TB block)

evals.name: entry-times-from-block-exits-option-1
evals.prompt: Build an OO signal CSV that opens trades at the same minute that block '20260319 - Sam Port' closed its trades between 2026-03-02 and 2026-03-13. Just entry times, no exits or strikes — I'll configure the strategy in OO's UI.

assertions.text: signal.csv exists somewhere under outputs/ (under an _all/ subfolder per the skill's convention)
Header row is exactly 'OPEN_DATETIME' (single column, no quoting, no extras)
CSV has at least one data row (Sam Port block has trades in the requested window)
Every OPEN_DATETIME value matches the regex ^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}$ (24-hour HH:MM, no seconds)
Every date in OPEN_DATETIME falls within the window 2026-03-02 to 2026-03-13 inclusive
No data value or header is wrapped in double quotes
A README.md exists in the same folder as signal.csv
A mirrored copy of the signal directory exists under outputs/by-block/20260319 - Sam Port/ (this signal IS block-tied)
The signal.csv content in _all/ and by-block/ is byte-identical

evals.name: entries-with-strikes-from-datelist-option-3
evals.prompt: I have a datelist CSV at /tmp/test-datelist.csv with one date per line. Generate an OO signal where each entry opens at 09:35 ET at strike 6500. I'm setting up the rest of the structure in OO.

assertions.text: signal.csv exists somewhere under outputs/ (under an _all/ subfolder per the skill's convention)
Header row is exactly 'OPEN_DATETIME,STRIKE' (Option 3 — two columns, in this order, no quoting)
CSV has exactly 8 data rows (matching the 8 dates in the input datelist)
Every OPEN_DATETIME value ends with ' 09:35' (24-hour, no seconds)
Every row has STRIKE = 6500 (no trailing zero like 6500.0)
No data value or header is wrapped in double quotes
A README.md exists in the same folder as signal.csv
No by-block/ subdirectory was created (the signal is not tied to a TB block)
